int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int gcd(int first, int second)
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return first

string fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator == 0
        return "-"
    if denominator < 0
        numerator = -numerator
        denominator = -denominator
    divisor := gcd(absolute(numerator), denominator)
    return "{numerator / divisor}/{denominator / divisor}"

int[][] matrix(int count)
    return [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then [for j := (0:<int(count))[] then 0]]

void accumulate(int[][] &counts, int[] truth, int[] prediction)
    for: t < int(#truth)
        counts[truth[t]][prediction[t]] += 1

int correct(int[] truth, int[] prediction)
    total := 0
    for: t < int(#truth)
        if truth[t] == prediction[t]
            total += 1
    return total

string padded(string value, int width)
    return " " * nat(width - int(#value)) + value

string[] matrix_lines(string[] states, int[][] counts)
    width := 1
    for row := counts[]
        for value := row[]
            if int(#string(value)) > width
                width = int(#string(value))
    header := " "
    for state := states[]
        header += " " + padded(state, width)
    result := [header]
    for: i < int(#states)
        row := states[i]
        for value := counts[i][]
            row += " " + padded(string(value), width)
        result = result.append(row)
    return result

string[] metric_lines(string[] states, int[][] counts)
    count := int(#states)
    rows := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then 0]
    columns := rows
    total := 0
    correct_count := 0
    for: i < count
        correct_count += counts[i][i]
        for: j < count
            rows[i] += counts[i][j]
            columns[j] += counts[i][j]
            total += counts[i][j]
    expected := 0
    for: i < count
        expected += rows[i] * columns[i]
    result := ["ACCURACY " + fraction(correct_count, total), "KAPPA " + fraction(total * correct_count - expected, total * total - expected)]
    for: i < count
        result = result.append("STATE {states[i]} precision " + fraction(counts[i][i], columns[i]) + " recall " + fraction(counts[i][i], rows[i]) + " f1 " + fraction(2 * counts[i][i], columns[i] + rows[i]))
    return result

int[][] runs(int[] path)
    int[][] result := []
    if #path == 0
        return result
    start := 0
    state := path[0]
    for: 1 <= t < int(#path)
        if path[t] != state
            result = result.append([state, start, t - 1])
            state = path[t]
            start = t
    return result.append([state, start, int(#path) - 1])

int matched_regions(int[][] first, int[][] second)
    total := 0
    for a := first[]
        for b := second[]
            if a[0] <= b[1] and b[0] <= a[1]
                total += 1
                break
    return total

int[] region_counts(int[][] predicted, int[][] truth)
    return [int(#predicted), int(#truth), matched_regions(predicted, truth), matched_regions(truth, predicted)]

int[] boundaries(int[] path)
    return [for t := (1:<int(#path))[] if path[t] != path[t - 1] then t]

int matched_boundaries(int[] first, int[] second, int tolerance)
    total := 0
    for a := first[]
        for b := second[]
            if absolute(a - b) <= tolerance
                total += 1
                break
    return total

int[] boundary_counts(int[] prediction, int[] actual, int tolerance)
    predicted := boundaries(prediction)
    truth := boundaries(actual)
    return [int(#predicted), int(#truth), matched_boundaries(predicted, truth, tolerance), matched_boundaries(truth, predicted, tolerance)]

import math

int maximum(real64[] values)
    best := 0
    for: 1 <= j < int(#values)
        if values[j] > values[best]
            best = j
    return best

real64[] emission_factors(real64[][] model, int observation, bool logarithms)
    count := int(#model[0])
    real64[] result := []
    for: state < count
        value := if observation < 0 then 1.0 else model[count + state + 1][observation]
        if logarithms
            value = math.log(value)
        result = result.append(value)
    return result

class ForwardBackward(real64[][] forward, real64[][] backward, real64[] scales, real64[][] emissions, real64[][] posterior, real64 loglik)

ForwardBackward scaled_forward(real64[][] model, int[] observations)
    count := int(#model[0])
    real64[][] forward := []
    real64[] scales := []
    real64[][] emissions := []
    real64 loglik := 0.0
    for: t < int(#observations)
        factors := emission_factors(model, observations[t], false)
        real64[] row := []
        real64 scale := 0.0
        for: j < count
            real64 value := 0.0
            if t == 0
                value = model[0][j] * factors[j]
            else
                real64 total := 0.0
                for: i < count
                    total += forward[t - 1][i] * model[i + 1][j]
                value = total * factors[j]
            row = row.append(value)
            scale += value
        for &value := &row[]
            value /= scale
        forward = forward.append(row)
        scales = scales.append(scale)
        emissions = emissions.append(factors)
        logarithm := math.log(scale)
        loglik += logarithm
    return ForwardBackward(forward, [], scales, emissions, [], loglik)

ForwardBackward forward_backward(real64[][] model, int[] observations)
    result := scaled_forward(model, observations)
    count := int(#model[0])
    length := int(#observations)
    result.backward = [for t := (0:<int(length))[] then [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]]
    result.backward[length - 1] = [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then 1.0]
    position := length - 2
    while position >= 0
        for: i < count
            real64 total := 0.0
            for: j < count
                total += model[i + 1][j] * result.emissions[position + 1][j] * result.backward[position + 1][j]
            result.backward[position][i] = total / result.scales[position + 1]
        position -= 1
    result.posterior = [for t := (0:<int(length))[] then [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then result.forward[t][i] * result.backward[t][i]]]
    return result

real64 transition_probability(real64[][] model, ForwardBackward result, int position, int state, int following)
    return result.forward[position][state] * model[state + 1][following] * result.emissions[position + 1][following] * result.backward[position + 1][following] / result.scales[position + 1]

(int[], real64) viterbi(real64[][] model, int[] observations)
    count := int(#model[0])
    real64[][] transitions := []
    for: i < count
        transitions = transitions.append([for value := model[i + 1][] then math.log(value)])
    factors := emission_factors(model, observations[0], true)
    real64[] scores := []
    for: j < count
        logarithm := math.log(model[0][j])
        scores = scores.append(logarithm + factors[j])
    predecessors := [[for j := (0:<int(count))[] then 0]]
    for: 1 <= t < int(#observations)
        factors = emission_factors(model, observations[t], true)
        real64[] next_scores := []
        int[] previous_states := []
        for: j < count
            candidates := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then scores[i] + transitions[i][j]]
            previous := maximum(candidates)
            previous_states = previous_states.append(previous)
            next_scores = next_scores.append(candidates[previous] + factors[j])
        scores = next_scores
        predecessors = predecessors.append(previous_states)
    length := int(#observations)
    path := [for t := (0:<int(length))[] then 0]
    path[length - 1] = maximum(scores)
    logprob := scores[path[length - 1]]
    position := length - 1
    while position > 0
        path[position - 1] = predecessors[position][path[position]]
        position -= 1
    return (path, logprob)

class Decoding(int[] viterbi_path, real64 logprob, int[] posterior_path, real64[] confidence, ForwardBackward fb)

Decoding decode(real64[][] model, int[] observations)
    fb := forward_backward(model, observations)
    path, logprob := viterbi(model, observations)
    int[] posterior_path := []
    real64[] confidence := []
    for row := fb.posterior[]
        chosen := maximum(row)
        posterior_path = posterior_path.append(chosen)
        confidence = confidence.append(row[chosen])
    return Decoding(path, logprob, posterior_path, confidence, fb)

import math
import model_io = "./model_io.qui"
import inference = "./inference.qui"
import training = "./training.qui"
import evaluation = "./evaluation.qui"
import sampler = "./sampler.qui"

int index_of(string[] values, string target)
    for: j < int(#values)
        if values[j] == target
            return j
    return -1

int integer(string text)
    result := int(text)
    return result

string uppercase(string text)
    const alphabet := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    result := ""
    for: j < int(#text)
        int code := text[j].codepoints()[0]
        result += if 97 <= code <= 122 then alphabet[code - 97] else text[j]
    return result

string lowercase_symbol(string text)
    const alphabet := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    return alphabet[text.codepoints()[0] - 65]

class Settings(local string[][] rows, local string[] states, local string[] symbols)
    int iterations := integer(rows[0][1])
    real64 pseudocount := model_io.number(rows[1][1])
    string[] smoothing := rows[2][1:<int(#rows[2])]
    int folds := integer(rows[3][1])
    int min_sequence_length := integer(rows[4][1])
    int max_missing_percent := integer(rows[5][1])
    int segment_state := index_of(states, rows[6][1])
    int merge_gap := integer(rows[7][1])
    int min_segment_length := integer(rows[8][1])
    int[] motif := [index_of(symbols, rows[9][1]), index_of(symbols, rows[9][2])]
    int[] rich_symbols := [for symbol := rows[10][1:<int(#rows[10])][] then index_of(symbols, symbol)]
    int min_rich_percent := integer(rows[11][1])
    int min_motif_percent := integer(rows[12][1])
    real64 confidence := model_io.number(rows[13][1])
    int boundary_tolerance := integer(rows[14][1])
    int posterior_seed := integer(rows[15][1])
    int posterior_samples := integer(rows[16][1])
    int sample_seed := integer(rows[17][1])
    int sample_count := integer(rows[18][1])
    int sample_length := integer(rows[19][1])

bool has_int(int[] values, int target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

class Record(string name, int[] observations, int[] path)

string rejection(string name, string text, string labels, bool labeled, string[] &seen, model_io.Model model, Settings settings)
    if index_of(seen, name) >= 0
        return "duplicate name"
    seen = seen.append(name)
    for: t < int(#text)
        character := text[t]
        if character != model.missing and index_of(model.symbols, character) < 0
            return "invalid symbol {character} at position {t + 1}"
    if labeled
        for: t < int(#labels)
            if index_of(model.states, labels[t]) < 0
                return "invalid label {labels[t]} at position {t + 1}"
        if #text != #labels
            return "length mismatch {#text} {#labels}"
    if int(#text) < settings.min_sequence_length
        return "too short {#text}"
    missing := 0
    for: t < int(#text)
        if text[t] == model.missing
            missing += 1
    if 100 * missing > settings.max_missing_percent * int(#text)
        return "too many missing {missing}"
    return ""

int[] encode(string text, string[] alphabet, missing := "")
    return [for t := (0:<int(#text))[] then (if text[t] == missing then -1 else index_of(alphabet, text[t]))]

int[][] observations(Record[] records)
    return [for record := records[] then record.observations]

int[][] true_paths(Record[] records)
    return [for record := records[] then record.path]

int positions(Record[] records)
    total := 0
    for record := records[]
        total += int(#record.observations)
    return total

string[] join_blocks(string[][] blocks)
    string[] result := []
    for: j < int(#blocks)
        if j > 0
            result = result.append("")
        result = result.concat(blocks[j])
    return result

(int[][], real64) viterbi_paths(real64[][] model, int[][] sequences)
    int[][] paths := []
    real64 total := 0.0
    for sequence := sequences[]
        path, logprob := inference.viterbi(model, sequence)
        paths = paths.append(path)
        total += logprob
    return (paths, total)

int[][] segments(int[] path, Settings settings)
    int[][] merged := []
    for state_run := evaluation.runs(path)[]
        if state_run[0] != settings.segment_state
            continue
        last := int(#merged) - 1
        if last >= 0 and state_run[1] - merged[last][1] - 1 <= settings.merge_gap
            merged[last][1] = state_run[2]
        else
            merged = merged.append([state_run[1], state_run[2]])
    return [for segment := merged[] if segment[1] - segment[0] + 1 >= settings.min_segment_length then segment]

(real64 | none, real64 | none, bool) composition(int[] sequence, int[] segment, Settings settings)
    observed := 0
    rich := 0
    first := 0
    second := 0
    pairs := 0
    for: segment[0] <= t <= segment[1]
        symbol := sequence[t]
        if symbol >= 0
            observed += 1
            if has_int(settings.rich_symbols, symbol)
                rich += 1
            if symbol == settings.motif[0]
                first += 1
            if symbol == settings.motif[1]
                second += 1
        if t < segment[1] and symbol == settings.motif[0] and sequence[t + 1] == settings.motif[1]
            pairs += 1
    real64 | none rich_fraction := if observed > 0 then real64(rich) / real64(observed) else none
    real64 | none pair_ratio := if first * second > 0 then real64(pairs * observed) / real64(first * second) else none
    island := first * second > 0 and 100 * rich >= settings.min_rich_percent * observed and 100 * pairs * observed >= settings.min_motif_percent * first * second
    return (rich_fraction, pair_ratio, island)

string path_text(int[] path, string[] alphabet)
    return [for state := path[] then alphabet[state]].join("")

(int[], int[], int) path_statistics(int[][] paths, int count)
    counts := [for state := (0:<int(count))[] then 0]
    runs := counts
    total := 0
    for path := paths[]
        total += int(#path)
        for state_run := evaluation.runs(path)[]
            counts[state_run[0]] += state_run[2] - state_run[1] + 1
            runs[state_run[0]] += 1
    return (counts, runs, total)

real64 | none mean_ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    return if denominator > 0 then real64(numerator) / real64(denominator) else none

real64[] stationary(real64[][] model)
    count := int(#model[0])
    real64[][] matrix := []
    for: equation < count - 1
        real64[] row := [for state := (0:<int(count))[] then model[state + 1][equation] - (if state == equation then 1.0 else 0.0)]
        matrix = matrix.append(row.append(0.0))
    matrix = matrix.append([for j := (0:<int(count + 1))[] then 1.0])
    for: column < count
        pivot := column
        for: column + 1 <= row < count
            candidate := matrix[row][column]
            previous := matrix[pivot][column]
            if (if candidate < 0.0 then -candidate else candidate) > (if previous < 0.0 then -previous else previous)
                pivot = row
        temporary := matrix[column]
        matrix[column] = matrix[pivot]
        matrix[pivot] = temporary
        divisor := matrix[column][column]
        for: column <= j <= count
            matrix[column][j] /= divisor
        for: row < count
            if row == column
                continue
            factor := matrix[row][column]
            for: column <= j <= count
                matrix[row][j] -= factor * matrix[column][j]
    return [for state := (0:<int(count))[] then matrix[state][count]]

int[][] permutations(int[] prefix, int count)
    if int(#prefix) == count
        return [prefix]
    int[][] result := []
    for: state < count
        if not has_int(prefix, state)
            result = result.concat(permutations(prefix.append(state), count))
    return result

class CrossValidation(string candidate, int correct_count, int[][] folds, int[][] matrix)

class Analysis(model_io.Model initial, string[][] sequence_rows, string[][] labeled_rows, local string[][] parameter_rows)
    settings := Settings(parameter_rows, initial.states, initial.symbols)
    Record[] sequences := []
    Record[] train_records := []
    Record[] test_records := []
    string[] rejections := []
    models := [initial]
    string[] baum_trace := []
    string[] viterbi_trace := []
    real64 first_loglik := 0.0
    real64 final_loglik := 0.0
    violations := 0
    best_iteration := 0
    viterbi_iterations := 0
    converged := false
    CrossValidation[] candidates := []
    selected_candidate := 0
    string[] cv_lines := []
    string[] learning_lines := []
    string[][] evaluation_blocks := []
    int[][] scores := []
    inference.Decoding[][] decoded := []

    void .validate()
        string[] seen := []
        for: j < int(#sequence_rows)
            name := sequence_rows[j][0]
            text := uppercase(sequence_rows[j][1])
            reason := rejection(name, text, "", false, &seen, initial, settings)
            if reason != ""
                rejections = rejections.append("REJECT sequences.txt line {j + 1} {name} {reason}")
            else
                sequences = sequences.append(Record(name, encode(text, initial.symbols, initial.missing), []))
        seen = []
        for: j < int(#labeled_rows) step 2
            name := labeled_rows[j][0]
            role := labeled_rows[j][1]
            text := uppercase(labeled_rows[j][2])
            labels := labeled_rows[j + 1][0]
            reason := rejection(name, text, labels, true, &seen, initial, settings)
            if reason != ""
                rejections = rejections.append("REJECT labeled.txt line {j + 1} {name} {reason}")
                continue
            record := Record(name, encode(text, initial.symbols, initial.missing), encode(labels, initial.states))
            if role == "TRAIN"
                train_records = train_records.append(record)
            else
                test_records = test_records.append(record)

    void .train_unsupervised()
        unlabeled := observations(sequences)
        heldout := observations(train_records.concat(test_records))
        current := initial.probabilities
        previous_loglik := training.total_loglik(current, unlabeled)
        first_loglik = previous_loglik
        best_heldout := training.total_loglik(current, heldout)
        baum_trace = ["iteration,loglik,heldout,change,max_change,status", "0," + model_io.decimal(first_loglik) + "," + model_io.decimal(best_heldout) + ",,,"]
        for: 1 <= int iteration <= settings.iterations
            updated := training.baum_welch_step(current, unlabeled, settings.pseudocount)
            loglik := training.total_loglik(updated, unlabeled)
            heldout_loglik := training.total_loglik(updated, heldout)
            real64 max_change := 0.0
            for: row < int(#current)
                for: column < int(#current[row])
                    difference := updated[row][column] - current[row][column]
                    if difference < 0.0
                        difference = -difference
                    if difference > max_change
                        max_change = difference
            violation := loglik < previous_loglik - 0.000001 * (if previous_loglik < 0.0 then -previous_loglik else previous_loglik)
            if violation
                violations += 1
            if heldout_loglik > best_heldout
                best_heldout = heldout_loglik
                best_iteration = iteration
            status := if violation then "violation" else "ok"
            baum_trace = baum_trace.append("{iteration}," + model_io.decimal(loglik) + "," + model_io.decimal(heldout_loglik) + "," + model_io.decimal(loglik - previous_loglik) + "," + model_io.decimal(max_change, 6) + ",{status}")
            current = updated
            previous_loglik = loglik
        final_loglik = previous_loglik
        models = models.append(model_io.Model("BAUM_WELCH", initial.states, initial.symbols, initial.missing, current))
        current = initial.probabilities
        paths, logprob := viterbi_paths(current, unlabeled)
        viterbi_trace = ["iteration,logprob,loglik,changed", "0," + model_io.decimal(logprob) + "," + model_io.decimal(first_loglik) + ","]
        for: 1 <= int iteration <= settings.iterations
            current = training.estimate_by_counting(initial.probabilities, unlabeled, paths, settings.pseudocount)
            next_paths, next_logprob := viterbi_paths(current, unlabeled)
            changed := 0
            for: j < int(#paths)
                changed += int(#paths[j]) - evaluation.correct(paths[j], next_paths[j])
            loglik := training.total_loglik(current, unlabeled)
            viterbi_trace = viterbi_trace.append("{iteration}," + model_io.decimal(next_logprob) + "," + model_io.decimal(loglik) + ",{changed}")
            paths = next_paths
            viterbi_iterations = iteration
            converged = changed == 0
            if converged
                break
        models = models.append(model_io.Model("VITERBI_TRAINING", initial.states, initial.symbols, initial.missing, current))

    void .train_supervised()
        train_positions := positions(train_records)
        test_positions := positions(test_records)
        for candidate := settings.smoothing[]
            matrix := evaluation.matrix(int(#initial.states))
            int[][] fold_results := []
            total_correct := 0
            for: int fold < settings.folds
                Record[] fitting := []
                Record[] validating := []
                for: j < int(#train_records)
                    if j % settings.folds == fold
                        validating = validating.append(train_records[j])
                    else
                        fitting = fitting.append(train_records[j])
                model := training.estimate_by_counting(initial.probabilities, observations(fitting), true_paths(fitting), model_io.number(candidate))
                fold_positions := 0
                fold_correct := 0
                for record := validating[]
                    path, logprob := inference.viterbi(model, record.observations)
                    fold_positions += int(#path)
                    fold_correct += evaluation.correct(record.path, path)
                    evaluation.accumulate(&matrix, record.path, path)
                total_correct += fold_correct
                fold_results = fold_results.append([int(#validating), fold_positions, fold_correct])
            candidates = candidates.append(CrossValidation(candidate, total_correct, fold_results, matrix))
            last := int(#candidates) - 1
            if candidates[last].correct_count > candidates[selected_candidate].correct_count
                selected_candidate = last
        selected := candidates[selected_candidate]
        alpha := model_io.number(selected.candidate)
        supervised := training.estimate_by_counting(initial.probabilities, observations(train_records), true_paths(train_records), alpha)
        models = models.append(model_io.Model("SUPERVISED", initial.states, initial.symbols, initial.missing, supervised))
        cv_lines = ["CROSS_VALIDATION folds {settings.folds}"]
        for candidate := candidates[]
            cv_lines = cv_lines.append("SMOOTHING {candidate.candidate} positions {train_positions} correct {candidate.correct_count} accuracy " + evaluation.fraction(candidate.correct_count, train_positions))
        cv_lines = cv_lines.append("SELECTED {selected.candidate}")
        for: int fold < settings.folds
            row := selected.folds[fold]
            cv_lines = cv_lines.append("FOLD {fold + 1} records {row[0]} positions {row[1]} correct {row[2]} accuracy " + evaluation.fraction(row[2], row[1]))
        cv_lines = cv_lines.concat(evaluation.matrix_lines(initial.states, selected.matrix)).concat(evaluation.metric_lines(initial.states, selected.matrix))
        learning_lines = ["LEARNING_CURVE"]
        for: 1 <= count <= int(#train_records)
            fitting := train_records[0:<count]
            model := training.estimate_by_counting(initial.probabilities, observations(fitting), true_paths(fitting), alpha)
            correct := 0
            for record := test_records[]
                path, logprob := inference.viterbi(model, record.observations)
                correct += evaluation.correct(record.path, path)
            learning_lines = learning_lines.append("RECORDS {count} correct {correct} accuracy " + evaluation.fraction(correct, test_positions))

    void .evaluate()
        for model := models[]
            results := [for record := test_records[] then inference.decode(model.probabilities, record.observations)]
            int[] totals := []
            for: decoder < 2
                name := if decoder == 0 then "VITERBI" else "POSTERIOR"
                matrix := evaluation.matrix(int(#model.states))
                regions := [0, 0, 0, 0]
                boundaries := regions
                calibration := [for bucket := (0:<10)[] then [0, 0]]
                string[] record_lines := []
                total_correct := 0
                for: j < int(#test_records)
                    record := test_records[j]
                    result := results[j]
                    path := if decoder == 0 then result.viterbi_path else result.posterior_path
                    correct := evaluation.correct(record.path, path)
                    total_correct += correct
                    evaluation.accumulate(&matrix, record.path, path)
                    truth := [for state_run := evaluation.runs(record.path)[] if state_run[0] == settings.segment_state then [state_run[1], state_run[2]]]
                    rc := evaluation.region_counts(segments(path, settings), truth)
                    bc := evaluation.boundary_counts(path, record.path, settings.boundary_tolerance)
                    for: k < 4
                        regions[k] += rc[k]
                        boundaries[k] += bc[k]
                    if decoder == 1
                        for: t < int(#path)
                            raw := math.floor(10.0 * result.confidence[t])
                            bucket := int(raw)
                            if bucket > 9
                                bucket = 9
                            calibration[bucket][0] += 1
                            if path[t] == record.path[t]
                                calibration[bucket][1] += 1
                    record_lines = record_lines.append("RECORD {record.name} length {#path} correct {correct}")
                block := ["EVALUATION {model.name} {name}"]
                block = block.concat(evaluation.matrix_lines(model.states, matrix)).concat(evaluation.metric_lines(model.states, matrix))
                block = block.append("REGIONS {model.states[settings.segment_state]} predicted {regions[0]} true {regions[1]} precision " + evaluation.fraction(regions[2], regions[0]) + " recall " + evaluation.fraction(regions[3], regions[1]))
                block = block.append("BOUNDARIES predicted {boundaries[0]} true {boundaries[1]} precision " + evaluation.fraction(boundaries[2], boundaries[0]) + " recall " + evaluation.fraction(boundaries[3], boundaries[1]))
                if decoder == 1
                    for: bucket < 10
                        row := calibration[bucket]
                        if row[0] == 0
                            continue
                        range := if bucket == 9 then "0.9-1.0" else "0.{bucket}-0.{bucket + 1}"
                        block = block.append("CALIBRATION {range} positions {row[0]} correct {row[1]} accuracy " + evaluation.fraction(row[1], row[0]))
                evaluation_blocks = evaluation_blocks.append(block.concat(record_lines))
                totals = totals.append(total_correct)
            scores = scores.append(totals)
            decoded = decoded.append([for record := sequences[] then inference.decode(model.probabilities, record.observations)])
        evaluation_blocks = evaluation_blocks.concat([cv_lines, learning_lines])

    void annotate()
        model := models[1]
        generator := sampler.Generator(settings.posterior_seed)
        string[] decoding_lines := []
        segment_lines := ["sequence,decoder,start,end,length,mean_posterior,support,rich_fraction,motif_ratio,island"]
        for: j < int(#sequences)
            record := sequences[j]
            result := decoded[1][j]
            int[][] samples := []
            sample_segments := 0
            for: int sample < settings.posterior_samples
                path := sampler.posterior_path(model.probabilities, result.fb.forward, &generator)
                samples = samples.append(path)
                sample_segments += int(#segments(path, settings))
            uncertain := 0
            confident := ""
            imputed := ""
            for: t < int(#record.observations)
                if result.confidence[t] < settings.confidence
                    uncertain += 1
                    confident += "."
                else
                    confident += model.states[result.posterior_path[t]]
                observation := record.observations[t]
                if observation >= 0
                    imputed += model.symbols[observation]
                else
                    real64[] probabilities := []
                    for: symbol < int(#model.symbols)
                        real64 total := 0.0
                        for: state < int(#model.states)
                            total += result.fb.posterior[t][state] * model.probabilities[int(#model.states) + state + 1][symbol]
                        probabilities = probabilities.append(total)
                    imputed += lowercase_symbol(model.symbols[inference.maximum(probabilities)])
            differences := int(#record.observations) - evaluation.correct(result.viterbi_path, result.posterior_path)
            decoding_lines = decoding_lines.concat(["SEQUENCE {record.name} length {#record.observations} loglik " + model_io.decimal(result.fb.loglik) + " viterbi " + model_io.decimal(result.logprob) + " differences {differences} uncertain {uncertain} expected_segments " + model_io.decimal(real64(sample_segments) / real64(settings.posterior_samples)), "VITERBI " + path_text(result.viterbi_path, model.states), "POSTERIOR " + path_text(result.posterior_path, model.states), "CONFIDENT " + confident, "IMPUTED " + imputed])
            for: decoder < 2
                name := if decoder == 0 then "viterbi" else "posterior"
                path := if decoder == 0 then result.viterbi_path else result.posterior_path
                for segment := segments(path, settings)[]
                    length := segment[1] - segment[0] + 1
                    real64 total := 0.0
                    for: segment[0] <= t <= segment[1]
                        total += result.fb.posterior[t][settings.segment_state]
                    support := 0
                    for sample := samples[]
                        count := 0
                        for: segment[0] <= t <= segment[1]
                            if sample[t] == settings.segment_state
                                count += 1
                        if 2 * count > length
                            support += 1
                    (real64 | none rich, real64 | none ratio, bool island) := composition(record.observations, segment, settings)
                    judgement := if island then "yes" else "no"
                    segment_lines = segment_lines.append("{record.name},{name},{segment[0] + 1},{segment[1] + 1},{length}," + model_io.decimal(total / real64(length)) + ",{support}," + model_io.optional(rich) + "," + model_io.optional(ratio) + ",{judgement}")
        model_io.write_lines("decodings.txt", decoding_lines)
        model_io.write_lines("segments.csv", segment_lines)

    void synthetic_output()
        model := models[1]
        generator := sampler.Generator(settings.sample_seed)
        string[] rows := []
        total_positions := 0
        viterbi_total := 0
        posterior_total := 0
        for: 1 <= int number <= settings.sample_count
            truth, sequence := sampler.synthetic(model.probabilities, settings.sample_length, &generator)
            result := inference.decode(model.probabilities, sequence)
            vc := evaluation.correct(truth, result.viterbi_path)
            pc := evaluation.correct(truth, result.posterior_path)
            total_positions += int(#truth)
            viterbi_total += vc
            posterior_total += pc
            rows = rows.concat(["SAMPLE {number} loglik " + model_io.decimal(result.fb.loglik) + " viterbi " + model_io.decimal(result.logprob) + " viterbi_correct {vc} posterior_correct {pc}", "STATES " + path_text(truth, model.states), "SYMBOLS " + path_text(sequence, model.symbols), "VITERBI " + path_text(result.viterbi_path, model.states), "POSTERIOR " + path_text(result.posterior_path, model.states)])
        rows = rows.append("TOTAL positions {total_positions} viterbi_accuracy " + evaluation.fraction(viterbi_total, total_positions) + " posterior_accuracy " + evaluation.fraction(posterior_total, total_positions))
        model_io.write_lines("samples.txt", rows)

    string[] input_report()
        Record[] labeled := train_records.concat(test_records)
        total_positions := positions(sequences)
        missing := 0
        labeled_missing := 0
        symbols := [for symbol := (0:<int(#initial.symbols))[] then 0]
        for record := sequences[]
            for symbol := record.observations[]
                if symbol < 0
                    missing += 1
                else
                    symbols[symbol] += 1
        for record := labeled[]
            for symbol := record.observations[]
                if symbol < 0
                    labeled_missing += 1
        rows := ["INPUT", "SEQUENCES accepted {#sequences} rejected {int(#sequence_rows) - int(#sequences)} positions {total_positions} missing {missing}", "LABELED train {#train_records} test {#test_records} rejected {int(#labeled_rows) / 2 - int(#labeled)} positions {positions(labeled)} missing {labeled_missing}"]
        rows = rows.concat(rejections)
        line := "COMPOSITION"
        for: symbol < int(#initial.symbols)
            line += " {initial.symbols[symbol]} " + model_io.decimal(real64(symbols[symbol]) / real64(total_positions - missing))
        rows = rows.append(line)
        for: role < 2
            records := if role == 0 then train_records else test_records
            name := if role == 0 then "TRAIN" else "TEST"
            counts, runs, total := path_statistics(true_paths(records), int(#initial.states))
            for: state < int(#initial.states)
                rows = rows.append("TRUTH {name} {initial.states[state]} occupancy " + model_io.decimal(real64(counts[state]) / real64(total)) + " mean_run " + model_io.optional(mean_ratio(counts[state], runs[state])))
        return rows

    string[] training_report()
        convergence := if converged then "yes" else "no"
        rows := ["TRAINING BAUM_WELCH iterations {settings.iterations} initial_loglik " + model_io.decimal(first_loglik) + " final_loglik " + model_io.decimal(final_loglik) + " violations {violations} best_heldout_iteration {best_iteration}", "TRAINING VITERBI_TRAINING iterations {viterbi_iterations} converged {convergence}", "TRAINING SUPERVISED smoothing {candidates[selected_candidate].candidate}"]
        preferences := [0, 0, 0, 0]
        for: j < int(#sequences)
            real64[] likelihoods := [for k := (0:<4)[] then decoded[k][j].fb.loglik]
            preferences[inference.maximum(likelihoods)] += 1
        line := "PREFERENCE"
        for: k < 4
            line += " {models[k].name} {preferences[k]}"
        rows = rows.append(line)
        total := positions(sequences)
        for: first < 3
            for: first + 1 <= second < 4
                correct := 0
                for: j < int(#sequences)
                    correct += evaluation.correct(decoded[first][j].viterbi_path, decoded[second][j].viterbi_path)
                rows = rows.append("AGREEMENT {models[first].name} {models[second].name} " + evaluation.fraction(correct, total))
        for: decoder < 2
            best := 0
            for: 1 <= k < 4
                if scores[k][decoder] > scores[best][decoder]
                    best = k
            name := if decoder == 0 then "VITERBI" else "POSTERIOR"
            rows = rows.append("BEST {name} {models[best].name} accuracy " + evaluation.fraction(scores[best][decoder], positions(test_records)))
        return rows

    string alignment(model_io.Model model)
        count := int(#model.states)
        matrix := evaluation.matrix(count)
        for record := train_records[]
            path, logprob := inference.viterbi(model.probabilities, record.observations)
            evaluation.accumulate(&matrix, record.path, path)
        int[] best := []
        best_correct := -1
        for permutation := permutations([], count)[]
            correct := 0
            for: j < count
                correct += matrix[permutation[j]][j]
            if correct > best_correct
                best_correct = correct
                best = permutation
        line := "ALIGNMENT"
        for: j < count
            line += " {model.states[j]}={model.states[best[j]]}"
        return line + " agreement " + evaluation.fraction(best_correct, positions(train_records))

    string[] model_report(int index)
        model := models[index]
        count := int(#model.states)
        real64 loglik := 0.0
        observed := 0
        segment_count := 0
        segment_length := 0
        islands := 0
        int[][] paths := []
        for: j < int(#sequences)
            record := sequences[j]
            result := decoded[index][j]
            loglik += result.fb.loglik
            paths = paths.append(result.viterbi_path)
            for symbol := record.observations[]
                if symbol >= 0
                    observed += 1
            for segment := segments(result.viterbi_path, settings)[]
                segment_count += 1
                segment_length += segment[1] - segment[0] + 1
                (real64 | none rich, real64 | none ratio, bool island) := composition(record.observations, segment, settings)
                if island
                    islands += 1
        counts, runs, total := path_statistics(paths, count)
        phi := stationary(model.probabilities)
        test_loglik := training.total_loglik(model.probabilities, observations(test_records))
        string[] rows := ["MODEL {model.name}", "LOGLIK unlabeled " + model_io.decimal(loglik) + " per_symbol " + model_io.decimal(loglik / real64(observed)) + " test " + model_io.decimal(test_loglik), "SEGMENTS count {segment_count} mean_length " + model_io.optional(mean_ratio(segment_length, segment_count)) + " islands {islands}", alignment(model)]
        for: state < count
            rows = rows.append("STATE {model.states[state]} stationary " + model_io.decimal(phi[state]) + " duration " + model_io.decimal(1.0 / (1.0 - model.probabilities[state + 1][state])) + " occupancy " + model_io.decimal(real64(counts[state]) / real64(total)) + " mean_run " + model_io.optional(mean_ratio(counts[state], runs[state])))
        return rows

    void .run()
        .validate()
        .train_unsupervised()
        .train_supervised()
        .evaluate()
        annotate()
        synthetic_output()
        trained := [for j := (1:<4)[] then model_io.model_lines(models[j])]
        model_io.write_lines("trained_model.txt", join_blocks(trained))
        model_io.write_lines("loglik_trace.csv", baum_trace)
        model_io.write_lines("viterbi_trace.csv", viterbi_trace)
        model_io.write_lines("evaluation.txt", join_blocks(evaluation_blocks))
        string[][] blocks := [input_report(), training_report()]
        for: j < 4
            blocks = blocks.append(model_report(j))
        model_io.write_lines("report.txt", join_blocks(blocks))

void run()
    initial, sequence_rows, labeled_rows, parameter_rows := model_io.read_inputs()
    analysis := Analysis(initial, sequence_rows, labeled_rows, parameter_rows)
    .analysis.run()

run()

import math

real64[] normalize(real64[] source)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for value := source[]
        total += value
    return [for value := source[] then value / total]

class Model(string name, string[] states, string[] symbols, string missing, real64[][] probabilities)

string[][] tokens(string name)
    string content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + name))
    rows := content.split(NL)
    return [for row := rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1][] then row.split(" ")]

real64 number(string text)
    result := real64(text)
    return result

(Model, string[][], string[][], string[][]) read_inputs()
    rows := tokens("model.txt")
    states := rows[0][1:<int(#rows[0])]
    symbols := rows[1][1:<int(#rows[1])]
    real64[][] probabilities := []
    probabilities = probabilities.append(normalize([for text := rows[3][1:<int(#rows[3])][] then number(text)]))
    for: 4 <= j < int(#rows)
        probabilities = probabilities.append(normalize([for text := rows[j][2:<int(#rows[j])][] then number(text)]))
    return (Model("INITIAL", states, symbols, rows[2][1], probabilities), tokens("sequences.txt"), tokens("labeled.txt"), tokens("params.txt"))

string decimal(real64 value, places := 4)
    scale := 1
    for: j < places
        scale *= 10
    absolute := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    rounded := math.floor(absolute * real64(scale) + 0.5)
    magnitude := int(rounded)
    sign := if value < 0.0 and magnitude != 0 then "-" else ""
    tail := string(magnitude % scale)
    return sign + string(magnitude / scale) + "." + "0" * nat(places - int(#tail)) + tail

string optional(real64 | none value)
    match value
        real64 present
            return decimal(present)
        none
            return "-"

string values(real64[] numbers)
    return [for value := numbers[] then decimal(value)].join(" ")

string[] model_lines(Model model)
    count := int(#model.states)
    rows := ["MODEL {model.name}", "STATES " + model.states.join(" "), "SYMBOLS " + model.symbols.join(" "), "MISSING {model.missing}", "INITIAL " + values(model.probabilities[0])]
    for: i < count
        rows = rows.append("TRANSITION {model.states[i]} " + values(model.probabilities[i + 1]))
    for: i < count
        rows = rows.append("EMISSION {model.states[i]} " + values(model.probabilities[count + i + 1]))
    return rows

void write_lines(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(rows.join(NL) + NL)

class Generator(int state)
    int .draw(real64[] weights)
        real64 total := 0.0
        for weight := weights[]
            total += weight
        state = (48271 * state) % 2147483647
        threshold := (real64(state) / 2147483647.0) * total
        real64 cumulative := 0.0
        for: j < int(#weights)
            cumulative += weights[j]
            if threshold < cumulative
                return j
        return int(#weights) - 1

(int[], int[]) synthetic(real64[][] model, int length, Generator &generator)
    count := int(#model[0])
    int[] states := []
    int[] observations := []
    for: t < length
        weights := if t == 0 then model[0] else model[states[t - 1] + 1]
        state := .generator.draw(weights)
        symbol := .generator.draw(model[count + state + 1])
        states = states.append(state)
        observations = observations.append(symbol)
    return (states, observations)

int[] posterior_path(real64[][] model, real64[][] forward, Generator &generator)
    count := int(#model[0])
    length := int(#forward)
    path := [for t := (0:<int(length))[] then 0]
    path[length - 1] = .generator.draw(forward[length - 1])
    position := length - 2
    while position >= 0
        following := path[position + 1]
        weights := [for state := (0:<int(count))[] then forward[position][state] * model[state + 1][following]]
        path[position] = .generator.draw(weights)
        position -= 1
    return path

import model_io = "./model_io.qui"
import inference = "./inference.qui"

real64[][] empty_counts(real64[][] template)
    count := int(#template[0])
    symbols := int(#template[count + 1])
    real64[][] result := [[for i := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]]
    for: i < count
        result = result.append([for j := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0])
    for: i < count
        result = result.append([for c := (0:<int(symbols))[] then 0.0])
    return result

real64[][] smoothed(real64[][] counts, real64 alpha)
    real64[][] result := []
    for row := counts[]
        result = result.append(model_io.normalize([for value := row[] then value + alpha]))
    return result

real64[][] baum_welch_step(real64[][] model, int[][] sequences, real64 pseudocount)
    count := int(#model[0])
    counts := empty_counts(model)
    for observations := sequences[]
        fb := inference.forward_backward(model, observations)
        for: state < count
            counts[0][state] += fb.posterior[0][state]
        for: t < int(#observations)
            observation := observations[t]
            for: state < count
                if observation >= 0
                    counts[count + state + 1][observation] += fb.posterior[t][state]
                if t + 1 < int(#observations)
                    for: following < count
                        counts[state + 1][following] += inference.transition_probability(model, fb, t, state, following)
    return smoothed(counts, pseudocount)

real64[][] estimate_by_counting(real64[][] template, int[][] observations, int[][] paths, real64 alpha)
    count := int(#template[0])
    counts := empty_counts(template)
    for: record < int(#paths)
        path := paths[record]
        counts[0][path[0]] += 1.0
        for: t < int(#path)
            state := path[t]
            observation := observations[record][t]
            if observation >= 0
                counts[count + state + 1][observation] += 1.0
            if t + 1 < int(#path)
                counts[state + 1][path[t + 1]] += 1.0
    return smoothed(counts, alpha)

real64 total_loglik(real64[][] model, int[][] sequences)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for observations := sequences[]
        result := inference.scaled_forward(model, observations)
        total += result.loglik
    return total
